NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMEND! APPLICATION

Applicant: Last Stash LLC

Property Location: 1500 N. Halsted, Chicago, IL 60642
Proposed Zoning: B3-5 Community Shopping District
Lot Area: 15,761 square feet

Last Stash LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 1500 N. Halsted, Chicago, IL 60642. The Applicant requests a re-zoning from the C3-5
Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District to the B3-5 Community Shopping District.
to convert the 2nd, 3rd and 4th floors from commercial office space into 31 units of multi-family
housing. The retail space on the first floor will remain. The building will have 31 bicycle spaces
and 15 total parking spaces including 1 ADA parking space. The floor area will remain at 36,941
square feet and building height at 55.67 feet.

The site is located at the northwest corer of North Halsted Street and West Blackhawk Street. To
the north is property zoned B3-5, to the east is property zoned PD 1075, to the south is property
zoned PD 1050 and to the west is property zoned C3-5.
NARRATIVE ZONING ANALYSIS
(a) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio:

i Lot area: 15,761 square feet

ii. Total proposed building area: 36,941 square feet (existing)

iii. Proposed FAR: 2.34
(b) Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 508 sffunit
(c) Amount of off-street parking: 15*

(d) Setbacks: 0 (existing)
(e) Building height: 55.67 (existing)
(f) Off-street Loading: 1 (10’x25”)

*Administrative adjustment pursuant to Section 17-13-1003-EE (Parking Reduction for Transit-Served
Locations) from 31 parking spaces to 15
